title: Phase 0.3: prove OAuth authorization and the authenticated MCP lifecycle
acceptance: the harness registers a client through DCR using the supported OpenCode loopback redirect shape
the harness drives Authorization Code flow with state and S256 PKCE, including the existing login/consent fixture boundary where required
a token exchange completes and yields a resource-bound access token without manual JWT construction
with that token, initialize, notifications/initialized, tools/list, and tools/call calendar_list are asserted end-to-end
tools/list asserts the expected nine tools each expose a description and complete input schema
current production behavior fails in this slice for the expected lifecycle/discovery reason, not because the harness calls the lab release binary
